name: delego-theme
title: Delego Theme
description: Delego design tokens mapped onto shadcn variables (OKLCH, light + dark). Electric-indigo primary, signal-mint accent, and the protocol decision palette (allow / needs_approval / deny). Pairs Inter (sans) + JetBrains Mono (mono); load the fonts in your app — see the registry README.

name: button
title: Button
description: Delego button — primary (indigo glow), secondary, ghost, outline, link, plus protocol-semantic allow/deny actions.

name: status-badge
title: Status Badge
description: Mono pill with leading icon + status color. Variants: allow, approval, deny, indigo (principal/audit), neutral.

name: decision-pill
title: Decision Pill
description: The signature Delego element: renders a Decision outcome (allow / needs_approval / deny) with its canonical icon, mono label, and color.

name: signed-receipt
title: Signed Receipt
description: The ownable audit visual — one hash-chained, Ed25519-signed ledger record, with the signal bar, seal, and mono kv grid.

name: field
title: Field
description: Labeled input with optional leading icon and mono hint, lit by the indigo focus halo. Drop-in over a native input.
